items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff details subdued Mercedes F1 celebrations after securing 2026 double
detailZh: 梅赛德斯在混乱的2026年圣保罗大奖赛上正式完成回归F1顶峰，成功锁定车队世界冠军头衔。然而，对于车队负责人兼CEO托托·沃尔夫来说，这一历史性里程碑并没有在巴西的夜总会举行盛大的庆祝活动。
梅赛德斯CEO托托·沃尔夫解释了他为什么在巴西跳过胜利派对，而是在私人飞机上独自喝了一杯伏特加。
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是所有关于银箭的最新消息，包括来自Brackley和Brixworth的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析。
梅赛德斯在圣保罗大奖赛上成功锁定车队世界冠军头衔，这是在基米·安东内利一周前获得车手冠军后实现的。但车队负责人和CEO托托·沃尔夫并没有在巴西的夜总会举行盛大的庆祝活动。
在最近的一次德国出版物《BILD》的采访中，沃尔夫透露了他的冠军庆祝活动实际上有多么低调。
当被问及是否有像迈克尔·舒马赫著名的百利甜和可乐那样的庆祝饮品时，沃尔夫表示他通常完全避免饮酒。
“我真的对此感到厌烦，”沃尔夫告诉该出版物。“我在赛季期间不喝酒，因为我需要保持100%的健康，而酒精会使我的时差反应更糟。”
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
但是，确保双冠王头衔需要在漫长的飞行回欧洲期间做出罕见的短暂例外。
沃尔夫表示，'在巴西比赛后的周日，我在飞机上和乔治·拉塞尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿喝了一杯伏特加。'
在私人飞机上与汉密尔顿分享胜利的饮料，这位著名车手在2025赛季前离开了梅赛德斯，为法拉利效力，这展示了两人之间持久的个人关系，尽管他们目前作为竞争对手在赛道上的竞争激烈。
当被问及为什么梅赛德斯领导层没有留在圣保罗举办一场正式的胜利派对时，这位奥地利高管直接指出了他巨大的企业义务。
“我不是仅仅一个车队负责人，我还是一个CEO，”沃尔夫解释道。“我无法承担一个派对假期——即使只是为了半天或一晚。”
承认在英国布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯工厂运营的庞大劳动力，沃尔夫指出他的工作立即转向车队下一个运营目标，而不是沉浸在最近的成功中。
乔治·拉塞尔、梅赛德斯、安德烈亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯、托托·沃尔夫、梅赛德斯
“在赛车队背后有超过1500名员工，他们是这个成功的一部分，”沃尔夫表示。“我必须为他们提供支持，就像我在赛道上为车队提供支持一样。尤其是我们不会因为成功和众多的祝贺而沾沾自喜。”
随着2026年的冠军头衔正式到手，沃尔夫确认工厂的焦点已经转向卫冕他们的冠军。
"是的，我们赢得了两个世界锦标赛，但我们希望明年再次做到这一点！"他总结道。
detailEn: Toto Wolff details subdued Mercedes F1 celebrations after securing 2026 double
Mercedes CEO Toto Wolff explains why he skipped a victory party in Brazil to take a single vodka shot on a private jet
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Mercedes officially completed its return to the top of Formula 1 at the chaotic 2026 São Paulo Grand Prix, successfully locking down the constructors' world championship one week after Kimi Antonelli secured the drivers' title. But for team principal and CEO Toto Wolff, the historic milestone was not met with an explosive nightclub celebration in Brazil.
In a recent interview with the German publication BILD, Wolff revealed exactly how subdued his championship celebrations actually were.
When asked if he had a go-to celebratory drink like Michael Schumacher's famous Bacardi and Cola, Wolff said he usually avoids alcohol entirely.
"I'm really bored with that," Wolff told the publication. "I don't drink alcohol during the season because I need to be 100% fit and alcohol makes my jet lag worse."
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
But securing a double championship warranted a rare, brief exception during the long flight back to Europe.
"On Sunday after the race in Brazil, I treated myself to a vodka shot on the plane with George Russell and Lewis Hamilton," Wolff stated.

Sharing a victory drink on a private jet with Hamilton, who famously departed Mercedes to drive for Ferrari ahead of the 2025 season, demonstrates the enduring personal relationship between the two men, despite their current on-track rivalry as competitors.
When pressed on why the Mercedes leadership did not stay in São Paulo to host a proper victory party, the Austrian executive pointed directly to his massive corporate obligations.
"No. I'm not just a team principal, I'm also a CEO," Wolff explained. "I can't afford a party holiday – even if it's only for a day or a night."

Acknowledging the massive workforce operating at the Brackley and Brixworth factories in the United Kingdom, Wolff noted that his job immediately shifts to the team's next operational target rather than resting on its recent success.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes

"Behind the race team are over 1500 employees who are part of this success," Wolff stated. "I have to be there for them just as I am for the team at the race track. Especially since we don't rest on our laurels over success and the many congratulations."
With the 2026 titles officially secured, Wolff confirmed that the factory's focus has already transitioned to defending their crown.
"Yes, we won both world championships, but we want to do that again next year!" he concluded.

items.summaryEn: Mercedes has already clinched both the 2026 constructors' and drivers' world championships in Brazil, and arrives in Las Vegas with a dual mandate: testing development parts for 2027 and securing second place in the drivers' standings for George Russell. Toto Wolff explained why Russell will not receive the team's new ADUO turbo upgrade in Las Vegas.
detailZh: 沃尔夫解释拉塞尔为何无缘梅赛德斯在拉斯维加斯的新涡轮
梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫解释了拉塞尔为何不会在拉斯维加斯大奖赛获得车队新的ADUO涡轮升级
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
梅赛德斯在巴西已正式锁定2026年车队和车手两项世界冠军，来到拉斯维加斯大奖赛时肩负双重任务：测试面向2027年的研发部件，并为拉塞尔锁定车手积分榜第二名。
为了实现第一个目标，银箭车队终于推出了在F1的额外开发与升级机会框架下开发的新涡轮规格。但只有一半的车库能用到它。
在车队的官方拉斯维加斯前瞻中，领队托托·沃尔夫解释了拒绝给拉塞尔升级的决定，确认新涡轮根本不值得为此承受发车格罚退。
“从本周末起，我们将拥有符合ADUO的涡轮规格，”沃尔夫表示。“这主要是为了在比赛周末条件下验证开发成果，预期的性能提升相对较小。
“我们预计让基米使用它，而对于乔治，我们的优先事项是保护他的发车位置，性能提升可能太有限，不足以证明接受发车格罚退是合理的，”沃尔夫补充道。
安东内利可以在不受罚的情况下测试新的涡轮，因为他仍在赛季配额之内，而拉塞尔已经超出了他的限额。
在拉斯维加斯故意接受发车位罚退，对拉塞尔的争冠形势可能是灾难性的。他目前以262分位列积分榜第三，仅落后红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘17分，同时还要守住对法拉利车队刘易斯·汉密尔顿仅一分的微弱优势。
“赢得两个世界冠军是一项了不起的成就，我们也花时间进行了庆祝，”沃尔夫说。“我们的目标很明确：帮助乔治在车手锦标赛中尽可能取得最高名次，带着势头结束这一年，并继续从赛车中挖掘更多性能。”
尽管拉塞尔错过了新硬件，梅赛德斯仍对它在1.9公里长的拉斯维加斯大道赛道上的整体速度感到乐观。
“因此，拉斯维加斯是下一个很好的挑战，”沃尔夫指出。“它很快就确立了自己作为一级方程式赛车最大赛事之一的地位……以拉斯维加斯大道为背景，赛历上再也没有其他能与之媲美。我们知道在那里获胜是什么感觉，我们当然想再次体验那种感觉。”
在内华达州的高速、严寒条件之后，围场将以中东背靠背赛事结束本赛季。沃尔夫赞扬了国际汽联（FIA）应对最后阶段后勤障碍的工作，并指出车队“很兴奋能在卡塔尔和阿布扎比的车迷面前为这一年收官”。
detailEn: Toto Wolff explains why George Russell won't get Mercedes’ new turbo in Las Vegas
Mercedes boss Toto Wolff explains why George Russell won't receive the team's new ADUO turbo upgrade at the Las Vegas GP
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Having officially wrapped up both the 2026 constructors' and drivers' world championships in Brazil, Mercedes arrives at the Las Vegas Grand Prix with a dual mandate: test development parts for 2027 and secure the runner-up spot in the drivers' standings for George Russell.

To accomplish the first goal, the Silver Arrows are finally introducing a new turbo specification developed under Formula 1's ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) framework. But only half the garage will get to use it.

In the team's official Las Vegas preview, team principal Toto Wolff explained the decision to deny Russell the upgrade, confirming that the new turbo simply is not worth the grid penalty it would incur.

"We will have the ADUO-enabled turbo specification available from this weekend," Wolff stated. "This is primarily about proving out the development in race-weekend conditions, with the expected performance benefit relatively small.
"We anticipate running it with Kimi, while with George our priority is protecting his grid position, with the performance benefit likely too limited to justify taking a grid penalty," Wolff added.
While Antonelli can test the new turbo without a penalty because he remains within his season allocation, Russell has already exceeded his limit.

Taking an intentional grid drop in Las Vegas could be catastrophic for Russell's championship positioning. He currently sits third in the standings on 262 points, trailing Red Bull's Max Verstappen by just 17 points while defending a razor-thin one-point advantage over Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton.

"Winning both world championships was an incredible achievement, and we have taken the time to celebrate that," Wolff said. "Our targets are clear: helping George finish as high as possible in the drivers’ championship, ending the year with momentum, and continuing to unlock more performance from the car."
Despite Russell missing out on the new hardware, Mercedes is optimistic about its overall pace on the 1.9-kilometre Las Vegas Strip.

"Las Vegas is therefore a good next challenge," Wolff noted. "It has established itself remarkably quickly as one of Formula 1's biggest events... With the Strip as the backdrop, there is nothing else quite like it on the calendar. We know what it feels like to win there and we would certainly like to experience that again."

Following the high-speed, freezing conditions of Nevada, the paddock will conclude the season with a Middle Eastern double-header. Wolff praised the FIA for dealing with the logistical hurdles of the final stretch, noting the team is "excited to finish the year" in front of the fans in Qatar and Abu Dhabi.

items.originalTitle: Liam Lawson has been a "revelation" as he earned 2027 Racing Bulls F1 deal - Alan Permane
items.summaryEn: Racing Bulls team principal Alan Permane said Liam Lawson's improved 2026 form has been a "revelation", after the team chose him over Red Bull junior Nikola Tsolov to partner Arvid Lindblad in 2027.
detailZh: 利亚姆·劳森堪称"惊喜"，他因此获得2027年小红牛F1席位——艾伦·佩尔曼
小红牛车队负责人艾伦·佩尔曼首次就他选择支持利亚姆·劳森而非尼古拉·措洛夫出战2027赛季一事接受采访
小红牛F1负责人艾伦·佩尔曼表示，利亚姆·劳森2026年状态的提升堪称"惊喜"，并回应了有关红牛内部愿景存在分歧的说法。
在接受Motorsport.com的一次广泛采访中，佩尔曼谈到了为何在现任车手劳森与红牛青训车手尼古拉·措洛夫之间选择与阿尔维德·林德布拉德搭档的决定耗时如此之久，以及为何支持劳森并不一定违背车队培养年轻人才的宗旨。
“有利亚姆在，对我们车队来说非常棒，这一点毫无疑问。他一直表现得极为出色，”佩尔曼说道。“可以说，他凭一己之力击败了阿尔派。但这不仅仅是关于这一点。这关乎培养年轻人才。老实说，如果没有一个基准，要做到这一点是极其困难的。
“我知道有关于让措洛夫上车的讨论，但我们留下利亚姆的原因之一，首先毫无疑问是因为他的表现，但这也是为了未来的发展。我们对阿尔维德评价非常、非常高，这将使他能够成长，也将使我们能够看到进展如何。
艾伦·佩尔曼，小红牛，利亚姆·劳森，小红牛
“利亚姆无疑有了巨大进步，而阿尔维德有这一切可以观察。我们在赛车之间共享所有这些数据，以及他在做什么、他如何在比赛中最大限度地发挥赛车性能。我认为这对阿尔维德来说绝对是无价的。”
有强烈迹象表明，这一延迟做出的决定是由于参与决策的各方利益相关者之间存在愿景分歧，其中不仅包括佩尔曼，还包括更广泛的红牛公司，包括佩尔曼的上级奥利弗·明茨拉夫以及红牛车队负责人洛朗·梅基斯。但佩尔曼与梅基斯口径一致，坚称这一决定是由小红牛做出的。
“洛朗在媒体上已经非常明确地表示，这不是他的决定，”佩尔曼坚称。“这是小红牛的决定，我在小红牛负责体育事务。这一点很清楚。不过，我有上级奥利弗·明茨拉夫，我们还有股东。”
“如此重要的决定不是我一个人做出的。这是我和我的上级以及股东共同做出的，确保他们满意。而这件事比你们希望的时间稍长一些，说实话，原因只是我在花时间确保我们做出正确的决定。”
detailEn: Liam Lawson has been a "revelation" as he earned 2027 Racing Bulls F1 deal - Alan Permane
Racing Bulls team principal Alan Permane has given his first interview on his decision to back Liam Lawson for 2027 over Nikola Tsolov
Racing Bulls Formula 1 chief Alan Permane says Liam Lawson's improved 2026 form has been a "revelation", and addressed suggestions of a difference in vision within Red Bull.

In a wide-ranging interview with Motorsport.com, Permane addressed why the decision between incumbent Lawson and Red Bull junior Nikola Tsolov to partner Arvid Lindblad had taken so long, and why backing Lawson doesn't have to go against the team's manta to bring up young talent.

"Having Liam is great for our team, there's no doubt. He's been immense," Permane said. "He's beaten Alpine on his own, if you like. But it's not just about that. It is about developing young talent. And honestly, that is incredibly difficult to do without having a benchmark.

"I know there was talk about putting Tsolov in the car, but one of the reasons we have kept Liam is firstly because of how he's performed, no doubt, but it's also about developing for the future. We rate Arvid very, very highly, and this will enable him to develop and it will enable us to see how that's going.
Alan Permane, Racing Bulls, Liam Lawson, Racing Bulls

"Liam has undoubtedly massively improved and Arvid has got all that to look at. We share all that data across cars and what's he doing and how is he getting the most out of the car in the race. And I think that's absolutely invaluable for Arvid."

There are strong suggestions the delayed decision was prompted by a difference in vision between the various stakeholders involved in the decision, which not only includes Permane but also the wider Red Bull company, including Permane's boss Oliver Mintzlaff as well as Red Bull Racing boss Laurent Mekies. But Permane echoed Mekies in insisting the call was made by Racing Bulls.

"Laurent has been very clear in the press that the decision is not his," Permane insisted. "It's a Racing Bulls decision and I'm responsible for sporting [matters] at Racing Bulls. That's clear. However, I have a boss, Oliver Mintzlaff, and we have shareholders as well.

"A decision as important as this isn't just made by myself. It's made by myself in conjunction with my boss and the shareholders, making sure they're happy. And the reason it's taken a little bit longer than you guys would like, honestly, is that I was just taking my time and making sure we got to the right decision."

detailZh: 如同惯例，多个一级方程式车队将在本周末的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上展示特别的涂装。
以下是目前已公布的全部涂装总结。
阿斯顿·马丁为了庆祝其人工智能云合作伙伴CoreWeave，为其特别的拉斯维加斯涂装使用了大量的白色和黑色。
阿斯顿·马丁将这种设计描述为‘数据、技术和性能如何结合以推动进步的视觉表达，从银石赛道上的AMR技术园区到拉斯维加斯大道的明亮灯光’。
这些颜色将遍布整个车库，并出现在拉塞尔·斯特罗尔的头盔上。
这辆涂装不仅展示了引擎合作伙伴本田的标志，还展示了制造商（主要位于美国）的豪华和性能部门Acura的标志。
凯迪拉克为其首赛季的第三场和最后一场主场比赛准备了另一款特别涂装。
车队表示："灵感来源于拉斯维加斯大道的灯光，这种半透明的、科技感十足的设计邀请粉丝深入了解。这是对凯迪拉克从零开始打造一级方程式车队的巨大努力背后的人们、决心和美国创新精神更深层次的致敬。"

Cadillac also had special liveries for Miami, Silverstone and most recently in Austin.
Williams has a striking blue chrome design for Las Vegas in tribute to its title sponsor Atlassian.

Williams said its "blue chrome FW48 will become a moving symbol of clarity and knowing by reflecting and amplifying the Strip's glow as Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz speed through the Nevada night. Beneath the chrome, exposed carbon shows the engineering discipline that every lap depends on".
Both Albon and Sainz will also have custom race suits and gloves, "plus a special, branded hot-laps car across the race week".

detailZh: 梅赛德斯计划在本周末的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，在其车手安东内利的F1赛车上引入期待已久的ADUO辅助涡轮升级。
梅赛德斯在2026年F1基准红牛引擎上落后2%至4%，根据F1的ADUO引擎追赶系统，允许其在2026年和2027年各进行一次升级。
升级是一款经过修改的涡轮，梅赛德斯已经为此准备了数月。
考虑到梅赛德斯在墨西哥和巴西周末的比赛中已经提前锁定了两个冠军头衔，还有三场比赛尚未进行，因此它几乎没有必要急于进行升级。
尽管如此，梅赛德斯在首秀这款发动机仍然具有价值，因为其发展将融入其2027年的套件。
这款发动机计划仅出现在安东内利的赛车在拉斯维加斯的比赛中。他不需要接受发车线处罚，因为他今年只使用了四个允许的涡轮增压器中的三个。
队友乔治·拉塞尔已经使用了五个，由于在新加坡接受了发车线处罚，所以如果他再在拉斯维加斯接受处罚，他将面临五位的发车线处罚。
“从本周末开始，我们将有ADUO启用的涡轮增压器规格可供使用，”梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫确认。
“这主要是为了证明在赛车周末条件下的开发，预期的性能提升相对较小。”
“我们预计会与基米一起运行，而与乔治一起，我们的首要任务是保护他的发车位置，因为性能提升可能过于有限，不足以证明接受发车罚分的合理性。”
“拉塞尔目前正在为争夺车手锦标赛第二名而战。他目前落后于马克斯·维斯塔潘17分，沃尔夫不排除使用车队指令来帮助拉塞尔获得第二名。”
“我还没有考虑过车手锦标赛，但显然我们绝对希望他获得最高分，并希望他最终获得第二名，我们需要考虑我们将如何做。”沃尔夫在巴西周日表示。
“但是，我们可能会全力以赴。”
在拉斯维加斯的预览引语中，沃尔夫清楚地提出了2026年剩余时间的目标。
“帮助乔治在车手锦标赛中尽可能取得高分，以势头结束这一年，并继续挖掘汽车的性能，”沃尔夫说。
“在这方面的努力还有更多，最后三场比赛给我们提供了三个学习和改进的机会。”
detailEn: Mercedes is planning to introduce its long-awaited Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities-assisted turbo on Kimi Antonelli's Formula 1 car in Las Vegas this weekend.

Mercedes has been judged to be between 2% and 4% adrift of F1 2026's benchmark Red Bull engine, meaning it is allowed one additional upgrade during 2026 and another for 2027 under F1's ADUO engine catch-up system.
The upgrade is a modified turbo, which Mercedes has been preparing for months.
It has felt little need to rush the upgrade, given it wrapped up both championship titles across the Mexico and Brazil weekends with three races still to go.
There is still value in Mercedes debuting it, however, as the development will feed into its 2027 package.
It is only planned to appear on Antonelli's car in Las Vegas. He does not need to take a grid penalty because he has only used three of the four permitted turbos this year.
Team-mate George Russell has already used five of them, having taken a grid penalty in Singapore, so he would face a five-place grid penalty had he taken another in Las Vegas.
"We will have the ADUO-enabled turbo specification available from this weekend," Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff confirmed.
"This is primarily about proving out the development in race-weekend conditions, with the expected performance benefit relatively small.
"We anticipate running it with Kimi, whilst with George our priority is protecting his grid position with the performance benefit likely too limited to justify taking a grid penalty."

Russell is currently fighting to secure second place in the drivers' championship. He is 17 points adrift of Max Verstappen right now, with Wolff not ruling out using team orders to help Russell secure it.

"I haven't thought about the drivers' championship yet, but clearly we absolutely want him to score the maximum and hopefully finish second, and we need to think about what we're going to do about it," Wolff said on Sunday in Brazil.
"But it could be a possibility that we're giving it all the force."
In his Las Vegas preview quotes, Wolff made the targets for the rest of 2026 clear.
"Helping George finish as high as possible in the drivers' championship, ending the year with momentum, and continuing to unlock more performance from the car," Wolff said.
"There is more work to do on that front, and the final three races give us three more opportunities to learn and improve."

items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff is not afraid of losing Kimi Antonelli to Ferrari
items.summaryEn: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff said he is "0.0%" afraid that Kimi Antonelli could one day switch to Ferrari, calling Antonelli and his family loyal people.
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫不担心失去基米·安东内利转投法拉利
托托·沃尔夫谈到基米·安东内利在其祖国意大利的地位，并解释了他为何不担心这位意大利车手在不久的将来转投法拉利
刘易斯·汉密尔顿、法拉利、安德烈亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫“0.0%”不担心基米·安东内利可能在F1中转投法拉利。
许多意大利人希望有朝一日能看到这位新科世界冠军坐进红色座舱，但据沃尔夫所说，这在可预见的未来不会发生。
“因为基米和他的家人都是忠诚的人，”沃尔夫向《图片报》解释道，并明确表示他“确信”安东内利不会突然背弃梅赛德斯。“但我们并非只依赖忠诚。
“本赛季已经表明，我们能够赢得比赛和冠军。这对任何车手来说都是最重要的。对基米也是如此。他属于梅赛德斯，就像车轮属于汽车一样。这就是为什么在赢得冠军后，他说他无法想象为梅赛德斯以外的任何车队效力。”
梅赛德斯自安东内利卡丁车时期起就一直支持他，陪伴他走过每一个青训系列赛并进入F1——以及在今年夺得冠军。据沃尔夫所说，这在安东内利与梅赛德斯之间，以及与他个人之间，建立了紧密的纽带。
“两三年前，他每次来布拉克利工厂时都住在我们家。他当时还是未成年人，所以我们不能随便把他安排到酒店。正因如此，他几乎成了我和[妻子]苏茜家里的常客，”这位奥地利人透露。
“晚上我们经常一起看电影——不过实际上只有我一个人在看，因为苏茜看一部电影撑不过10分钟就会睡着，而基米在那些高强度的日子过后已经筋疲力尽。然后他们俩就肩并肩睡着了，我一个人把电影看完。”
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
比迈克尔·舒马赫更受欢迎？
沃尔夫表示，安东内利不为法拉利效力这一事实，并不会削弱他在祖国的人气。这位奥地利人认为，这位出生于博洛尼亚的车手在意大利“绝对”比迈克尔·舒马赫在法拉利时期更受欢迎。
“毕竟他是意大利人，”沃尔夫说，并补充道：“基米凭借他天生的举止和成功所取得的成就是，意大利仍然自然而然地支持自己的国家队法拉利，但也向这个小小的意大利人敞开了心扉和灵魂。”
“铁杆车迷（Tifosi）现在穿着法拉利衬衫，戴着梅赛德斯帽子。蒙扎就是完美的例子。观众们实际上对两辆红色赛车都没有获得第一名感到难过，但他们很高兴他们自己人之一，基米，站在了领奖台的最高处。”
如果沃尔夫如愿以偿，意大利人将需要他们的梅赛德斯帽子很多年。
detailEn: Toto Wolff is not afraid of losing Kimi Antonelli to Ferrari
Toto Wolff discusses Kimi Antonelli’s status in his home country and explains why he is not afraid that the Italian could move to Ferrari in the near future
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff is “0.0%” afraid that Kimi Antonelli could switch to Ferrari in Formula 1.
Many Italians would love to see the new world champion in a red cockpit one day, but according to Wolff, that will not happen in the foreseeable future.

“Because Kimi and his family are loyal people,” Wolff explained to Bild, making clear that he is “convinced” Antonelli will not suddenly turn his back on Mercedes. “But we are not relying solely on loyalty.

“This season has shown that we can win races and titles. That is the most important thing for any driver. For Kimi too. He belongs at Mercedes like wheels belong on a car. That is why, after winning the title, he said that he cannot imagine driving for any team other than Mercedes.”

Mercedes has supported Antonelli since his karting days and accompanied him through every junior series and into F1 – and, this year, to the title. According to Wolff, this has created a close bond between Antonelli and Mercedes, as well as with him personally.

“Two or three years ago, he always stayed at our home when he was at the factory in Brackley. He was still a minor, so we could not simply put him in a hotel. That is why he was practically a permanent guest at [wife] Susie’s and my place,” the Austrian revealed.

“In the evenings, we often watched films together – although it was really only me, because Susie cannot stay awake through a film for more than 10 minutes and Kimi was completely exhausted after the intense days. Then the two of them fell asleep shoulder to shoulder, and I watched the film on my own.”
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
More popular than Michael Schumacher?

According to Wolff, the fact that Antonelli does not drive for Ferrari does not diminish his popularity in his home country. The Austrian believes the Bologna-born racer is “definitely” more popular there than Michael Schumacher was during his Ferrari years.

“He is Italian, after all,” Wolff said, adding: “What Kimi has achieved through his natural demeanour and success is that Italy still naturally roots for its national team, Ferrari, but has also opened its heart and soul to this little Italian.

“The Tifosi now wear Ferrari shirts with Mercedes caps. Monza was the perfect example. The spectators were actually sad that neither of the red cars finished first, but they were happy that one of their own, Kimi, stood at the very top of the podium.”
And if Wolff has his way, Italians will need their Mercedes caps for many more years.

detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索将在2027年F1赛季开始前代表阿斯顿·马丁参加达喀尔拉力赛。
阿隆索曾在2020年离开F1期间参加这项传奇的沙漠马拉松赛事，代表丰田获得第13名。
他长期以来公开表示自己很想再次挑战达喀尔，但就在上个月他还淡化了即将回归的说法，称“很难安排，尤其是在同一年兼顾F1和达喀尔这两项挑战”。
但他现在已决定，在同一赛季同时参加这两项赛事正是他想迎接的挑战，并表示这一决定在他确认2027年继续留在阿斯顿·马丁征战F1后变得明确。两年前与阿斯顿·马丁达成上一份合同时，他就曾把达喀尔列为F1之外的重要目标。
阿隆索表示：“最终，这个决定变得很简单。”
“我想完全拥抱这项挑战，在同一年同时征战一级方程式和达喀尔拉力赛。”
“2020年，达喀尔是我职业生涯中最具挑战性也最令人愉快的经历之一。我对这项赛事以及精通它的专家们怀有极大的敬意。”
由于中东持续的安全局势，明年的达喀尔拉力赛已从原计划的沙特阿拉伯路线改至葡萄牙和摩洛哥。
比赛于1月9日至23日举行，比2月24日至27日的一级方程式季前测试早一个月。
阿隆索的队友将是九届世界拉力锦标赛冠军、如今常驻达喀尔领奖台的塞巴斯蒂安·勒布，以及现任世界拉力突袭锦标赛冠军卢卡斯·莫赖斯。
五届达喀尔摩托车组冠军马克·科马将担任阿隆索的领航员，正如他们在2020年的尝试中一样。
阿斯顿·马丁的达喀尔项目将使用“无畏”品牌，该品牌迄今仅以数字形式存在，是为游戏《使命召唤：现代战争4》创作的军用概念车。
它将由传奇的Prodrive团队运营，该团队今年与之前的合作伙伴Dacia一起赢得了达喀尔拉力赛。
阿隆索在2010年代末期在F1之外的冒险包括三次印第安纳波利斯500大赛的尝试——结果从争夺胜利到未能获得参赛资格不等——两次勒芒24小时耐力赛胜利、一个世界耐力锦标赛冠军和一次戴通纳24小时耐力赛胜利。
他最近表示，达喀尔是所有这些中最艰难的任务，因为它与F1所需的技能和风格如此不同。
“对我来说，对一名F1车手来说，这是最困难的挑战，”阿隆索上个月说，“因为在驾驶技术和如何解读地形方面，以及用双脚驾驶赛车的方式——始终同时踩刹车和油门以稳定赛车——它与F1的差异不可能更大了。”
“这与F1完全相反，所以这正是它吸引人的地方。”
阿隆索首次尝试达喀尔的表现如何
阿隆索在2020年首次尝试达喀尔时整体上颇具竞争力。
他受益于一套强大的装备——由Gazoo车队准备的丰田Hilux，该车曾与纳赛尔·阿提亚和吉尼尔·德·维利尔斯一起长期位居前列，达喀尔摩托车传奇科马则担任领航员——最终他以第13名完赛，落后冠军4小时43分钟。
其中仅一小时多一点的损失可以追溯到两个赛段，他在那里因撞上岩石受损和翻车而被迫停车维修。
除此之外，他始终稳定地处于前列附近，在一半的赛段中跻身前七——其中亮点是在第八赛段借助赛道位置优势获得第二名。
阿提亚后来表示，阿隆索的即时速度非常突出，但他可能需要积累更多达喀尔经验，才能考虑尝试夺冠。
“他非常非常有天赋，”阿提亚在2022年说道。
“而他在达喀尔首次做到的是——他展现出了速度。对于这类比赛，你真的需要经验。
“因为，如果你看看达喀尔的历史，你需要有大约四、五、六年的经验，然后才能获胜。”
detailEn: Fernando Alonso will contest the Dakar Rally with Aston Martin ahead of the 2027 Formula 1 season starting.
Alonso competed on the legendary desert marathon in 2020 while on his break from F1, finishing 13th with Toyota.

He has long openly admitted that he would love to tackle the Dakar again, though as recently as last month he played down talk of an imminent return, saying it would be "difficult to fit, especially in the same year, both challenges - Formula 1 and Dakar".

But he has now decided that competing in both in the same season is exactly the challenge he wants to take on, saying that was a decision that crystallised once he'd committed to staying in F1 with Aston Martin for 2027. He had highlighted Dakar as a key non-F1 goal when agreeing his previous deal with Aston Martin two years ago.
"In the end, the decision became simple," said Alonso.
"I wanted to embrace the challenge completely and take on both Formula 1 and the Dakar Rally in the same year.
"In 2020, Dakar was one of the most challenging and enjoyable experiences of my career. I have enormous respect for this race and the specialists who have mastered it."
Next year's Dakar has moved from its planned Saudi Arabian route to Portugal and Morocco due to the ongoing security situation in the Middle East.
It takes place from January 9-23, a month before F1 pre-season testing on February 24-27.
Alonso's team-mates will be nine-time World Rally champion turned regular Dakar podium finisher Sebastien Loeb and reigning World Rally Raid champion Lucas Moraes.
Marc Coma, a five-time Dakar winner in the motorcycle class, will be Alonso's co-driver just as he was for their 2020 attempt.
Aston Martin's Dakar project will use the Dreadnought brand that has so far only existed in digital form, created as a military concept vehicle for the game Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
It will be run by the legendary Prodrive operation that won this year's Dakar with its previous partner Dacia.

Alonso's adventures outside F1 in the late-2010s included three Indianapolis 500 attempts - in which the outcomes ranged from fighting for victory to failing to quality - two Le Mans 24 Hours victories, a World Endurance Championship title and a Daytona 24 Hours win.
He recently said Dakar had been the hardest mission of them all because it is so different to the skillset and style required for F1.

"That's the most difficult challenge for me, for a Formula 1 driver," Alonso said last month, "because it cannot be more different than F1 in terms of driving techniques and how to read the terrain, and the way you drive the car also with both feet - on brake and throttle all the time to stabilise the car.
"It's completely the opposite of F1, so that's why it's appealing."
How Alonso fared in his first Dakar attempt
Alonso was broadly competitive when trying out the Dakar for the first time in 2020.

He benefitted from a strong package - a Toyota Hilux prepared by the Gazoo team that had been a perennial frontrunner with Nasser Al-Attiyah and Giniel de Villiers, with Dakar bikes legend Coma stepping in as co-driver - and ultimately reached the finish in 13th, 4h43m down on the winner.
Just over an hour of that time loss could be tracked to a pair of stages in which he was halted by repairs for a damaging rock impact and a roll.
He was otherwise reliably there or thereabouts, a top-seven finisher on half the stages - with the highlight a track position-aided second place on stage eight.
Al-Attiyah later said that Alonso's immediate speed had stood out, but that he might need a lot more Dakar experience before he could think about trying to win it.
"He's very, very talented," said Al-Attiyah in 2022.
"And what he did for the first time in the Dakar - he showed the speed. For this kind of race you need to really have experience.
"Because, if you see the history of Dakar, you need to have like four, five, six years' experience, and then you win."

items.originalTitle: Fernando Alonso to return to Dakar Rally with Aston Martin in 2027
items.summaryEn: Two-time Formula 1 world champion Fernando Alonso has been confirmed to race for Aston Martin's factory team in the 2027 Dakar Rally, joining Sebastien Loeb and Lucas Moraes in the line-up. He will drive a Prodrive-built Aston Martin Dreadnought in the 49th edition of the Dakar.
detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索将于2027年代表阿斯顿·马丁重返达喀尔拉力赛。
经过数月猜测，现已确认阿隆索将于明年参加达喀尔，作为Prodrive运营的阿斯顿·马丁车队的一员。
两届F1世界冠军费尔南多·阿隆索将作为阿斯顿·马丁厂队参加2027年达喀尔拉力赛的核心人物，与塞巴斯蒂安·勒布和卢卡斯·莫赖斯一同组成星光熠熠的阵容。
阿隆索将驾驶Prodrive打造的阿斯顿·马丁Dreadnought出战第49届达喀尔拉力赛。该赛事在从原定举办地沙特阿拉伯迁出后，将于2027年1月9日至23日在葡萄牙和摩洛哥举行。
这将标志着这位西班牙人自2020年随丰田完成令人印象深刻的达喀尔首秀以来，首次重返这项全球最受欢迎的拉力越野赛事，当时他获得总成绩第13名，并在第8赛段取得第二名。
这位45岁的车手将再次与马克·科马搭档，后者曾五次获得达喀尔摩托车组冠军，将在这为期两周的马拉松赛事中担任他的领航员。
阿隆索表示：“在决定继续代表阿斯顿·马丁征战一级方程式后，我仔细考虑了达喀尔的事。最终，决定变得很简单。我想全身心迎接挑战，在同一年同时参加一级方程式和达喀尔拉力赛。”
“2020年，达喀尔是我职业生涯中最具挑战性也最令人愉快的经历之一。我对这项赛事以及那些精通它的专家们怀有极大的敬意。
“马克再次与我并肩作战非常重要，而与阿斯顿·马丁、Prodrive、塞巴斯蒂安和卢卡斯一起，我们拥有一支非凡的车队。”
“一级方程式仍然是我的优先事项。但我是一名赛车手，正是这样的挑战让我热爱竞争。我期待看到我们能取得怎样的成就。”
#310 丰田Gazoo Racing车队：费尔南多·阿隆索
阿隆索长期以来一直怀有重返达喀尔的愿望，即便他仍将主要精力放在留在F1上。在他于9月与阿斯顿·马丁续约后，关于他参加2027年赛事的猜测愈演愈烈。
据了解，这位西班牙人还于10月在摩洛哥测试了一辆原型车，此前这个非洲国家被确认为2027年达喀尔拉力赛的主要主办地。拉力赛车手经常在摩洛哥进行测试，为即将到来的赛季做准备，那里广袤的沙漠是达喀尔拉力赛的理想测试场地。
阿隆索参加达喀尔拉力赛的消息于周二得到确认，阿斯顿·马丁宣布将作为厂队历史上首次参加这项世界上最受欢迎的拉力赛。
这家英国制造商将与赛车运动巨头Prodrive一起争夺总冠军荣誉，延续双方已经涵盖GT赛车和此前原型车项目的成功合作关系。
阿斯顿·马丁将参赛的赛车被命名为无畏舰，该车最初是为热门《使命召唤》游戏系列构思的一款纯数字军用车辆。
据了解，Dreadnought 是此前以 Dacia Sandrider 名义参赛的原型车的最新迭代版本，直到雷诺集团在今年与纳赛尔·阿提亚一起赢得胜利后退出越野拉力赛。
Prodrive 也曾运营达契亚的厂商项目，它在夏天与多家制造商就接管 Sandrider 项目进行了讨论，之后与阿斯顿·马丁达成了协议。
阿斯顿·马丁首席执行官阿德里安·霍尔马克表示：“阿斯顿·马丁 Dreadnought 的构想是在最极端的环境下主宰任何地形，并经受住一切考验以完成其使命。”
“现在，我们将与我们的工程合作伙伴 Prodrive 一起，在全球赛车运动中最极端的竞争环境——2027 年达喀尔拉力赛中——挑战这一愿景。”
“开拓先锋理念是阿斯顿·马丁的本性，正如我们一贯所做的那样，在全球舞台上探索它们的极限。”
“我们不回避这样的挑战，而是拥抱它们，有了费尔南多、塞巴斯蒂安和卢卡斯，我们拥有三位伟大的冠军，可以与之一同向2027年达喀尔发起强有力的挑战。”
#219 达契亚 Sandriders 达契亚：塞巴斯蒂安·勒布
阿斯顿·马丁还将倚重九届世界拉力锦标赛冠军勒布的经验，他自2021年起便加入Prodrive的体系，先是Bahrain Raid Xtreme，随后是达契亚。
在与包括福特和丰田在内的多家制造商进行洽谈后，这位法国人将代表阿斯顿·马丁参加他的第11次达喀尔拉力赛，继续追逐他的首个冠军。
“赢得达喀尔对我来说非常重要，”勒布说道。“我们曾多次接近胜利，而继续努力直到实现目标的动力一直都在。与阿斯顿·马丁和Dreadnought一起迎接这一挑战是一个绝佳的机会。这是一个拥有特殊赛车运动故事的品牌，若能帮助它首次赢得达喀尔，我会感到非常自豪。
“这场比赛已多次证明，它需要的远不止速度。你必须应对艰难的日子，照顾好赛车，并保持专注直到终点。有法比安在我身边，还有费尔南多和卢卡斯，我们将把所有的经验带到团队的项目准备和开发中。面对一辆新车有很多东西要学，而我很享受与工程师们一起做这项工作。目标是到达起点时已准备好为胜利而战。”
阿斯顿的达喀尔阵容将由莫赖斯补全，他曾在2025年随丰田赢得世界拉力-越野锦标赛冠军，之后于今年转投达契亚。
在雷诺集团退出后，勒布和莫赖斯都留在Prodrive，而阿提亚和克里斯蒂娜·古铁雷斯成为仅有的两位在2027年尚无席位的达契亚车手。前者如今是史上最成功的拉力赛车手之一，拥有六次达喀尔冠军，但尚未宣布下赛季的计划。
detailEn: Fernando Alonso to return to Dakar Rally with Aston Martin in 2027
Following months of speculation, it has been confirmed that Alonso will race in the Dakar next year as part of the Prodrive-run Aston Martin squad
Two-time Formula 1 champion Fernando Alonso will headline Aston Martin’s factory entry into the Dakar Rally in 2027, joining Sebastien Loeb and Lucas Moraes as part of a star-studded line-up.

Alonso will drive a Prodrive-built Aston Martin Dreadnought in the 49th edition of Dakar, which will take place in Portugal and Morocco from 9-23 January 2027 after being relocated from its original location in Saudi Arabia.

This will mark the Spaniard’s first appearance in the world’s most popular rally-raid since his impressive debut with Toyota in 2020, when he finished 13th overall and recorded a second-place finish on Stage 8.
The 45-year-old will reprise his partnership with Marc Coma, a five-time Dakar winner on motorcycles, who will serve as his navigator for the two-week marathon.

“After deciding to continue racing in Formula 1 with Aston Martin, I thought carefully about Dakar,” said Alonso. “In the end, the decision became simple. I wanted to embrace the challenge completely and take on both Formula 1 and the Dakar Rally in the same year.
“In 2020, Dakar was one of the most challenging and enjoyable experiences of my career. I have enormous respect for this race and the specialists who have mastered it.
“Having Marc alongside me again is very important, and with Aston Martin, Prodrive, Sebastien and Lucas we have an exceptional team.
“Formula 1 remains my priority. But I am a racing driver, and challenges like this are why I love competing. I’m looking forward to seeing what we can achieve.”
#310 Toyota Gazoo Racing: Fernando Alonso

Alonso had long harboured aspirations of returning to the Dakar, even as he continued to put his primary focus on remaining in F1. Speculation about a 2027 entry intensified after he extended his contract with Aston Martin in September.

The Spaniard is also understood to have tested a prototype version of the car in Morocco in October, before the African nation was confirmed as the primary host for the 2027 Dakar. Rally drivers regularly test in Morocco to prepare for the forthcoming season, with its vast deserts serving as an ideal testing ground for the Dakar.
Alonso’s participation in the Dakar was confirmed on Tuesday, as Aston Martin announced that it will be entering the world’s most popular rally-raid as a factory team for the first time in history.
The British manufacturer will compete for outright honours with motorsport powerhouse Prodrive, extending a successful partnership that already encompasses GT racing and previous prototype ventures.
The car that Aston Martin will enter has been badged as Dreadnought, which was first conceived as a digital-only military vehicle for the popular Call of Duty game series.

Dreadnought is understood to be the latest iteration of the prototype that previously competed as the Dacia Sandrider until the Renault Group pulled out of cross-country rallying following its victory with Nasser Al-Attiyah this year.

Prodrive, which also ran the factory Dacia programme, held discussions with multiple manufacturers about taking over the Sandrider project in the summer before reaching an agreement with Aston Martin.
“Aston Martin Dreadnought was conceived to dominate any terrain, under the most extreme circumstances, and come through it all to deliver on its mission,” said Aston Martin CEO Adrian Hallmark.
“Now along with our engineering partner, Prodrive, we will challenge this vision in the most extreme competitive environment in global motorsport – the Dakar 2027.
“It is in Aston Martin’s nature to forge forward with pioneering concepts, and just as we have always done, explore their limits on the global stage.
“We do not shy away from such challenges, but embrace them, and in Fernando, Sebastien and Lucas we have three great champions with whom to mount a formidable challenge on Dakar 2027.”
#219 The Dacia Sandriders Dacia: Sebastien Loeb
Aston Martin will also count on the experience of nine-time World Rally champion Loeb, who has been part of Prodrive’s set-up since 2021, first as Bahrain Raid Xtreme and subsequently Dacia.
After holding talks with several manufacturers, including Ford and Toyota, the Frenchman will contest his 11th Dakar with Aston Martin as he continues his pursuit of a maiden win.

“Winning the Dakar is very important to me,” said Loeb. “We have come close several times, and the motivation is there to keep working until we achieve it. To take on this challenge with Aston Martin and Dreadnought is a great opportunity. It is a brand with a special motorsport story, and I would feel very proud to help it win the Dakar for the first time.

“This race has proved many times that it demands much more than speed. You have to manage the difficult days, look after the car and stay focused until the finish. With Fabian alongside me, and with Fernando and Lucas, we will bring all our experience to the preparation and development of the programme as a team. There is a lot to learn with a new car, and I enjoy that work with the engineers. The objective is to arrive at the start ready to fight for victory.”
Aston’s Dakar line-up will be completed by Moraes, who won the 2025 World Rally-Raid Championship with Toyota before moving to Dacia this year.

With both Loeb and Moraes remaining with Prodrive following Renault Group’s exit, Al-Attiyah and Cristina Gutierrez remain the only Dacia drivers left without a seat for 2027. The former, now one of the most successful rally drivers of all time with six Dakar wins, has yet to announce his plans for next season.

“开拓先锋概念是阿斯顿·马丁的本性，正如我们一贯所做的那样，在全球舞台上探索它们的极限。我们不回避这样的挑战，而是拥抱它们，有了费尔南多、塞巴斯蒂安和卢卡斯，我们拥有三位伟大的冠军，与他们一起向 2027 年达喀尔拉力赛发起强有力的挑战。”
该赛事总里程达 7,824 公里，其中包括 4,341 公里的特殊赛段，并涵盖各种具有挑战性的地形和沙漠条件。

detailEn: Fernando Alonso: Aston Martin driver to race in Dakar Rally ahead of 2027 F1 season in return to rally-raid event

Aston Martin's F1 driver joins the marque's first foray into the hugely-challenging Dakar Rally in January; 2027 event being held in Portugal and Morocco; watch the Las Vegas GP this weekend on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 4am on Saturday and the race at 4am on Sunday
Fernando Alonso will race in the Dakar Rally for Aston Martin in January.
The 45-year-old will return to compete in the legendary off-road endurance event seven years on from his one previous appearance, when he finished 13th with Toyota.

That came during Alonso's two-year stint out of Formula 1 but this time he will race in Dakar ahead of what will be a record-extending 24th campaign in the sport after he extended his deal with Aston Martin's F1 team for the 2027 season.

The 2027 edition of the rally-raid event is being held in Portugal and Morocco on January 9-23 after being moved from Saudi Arabia due to the conflict in the Middle East. The race will feature a prologue and 12 different stages across different challenging terrains.

Alonso's co-driver will again be compatriot Marc Coma, who is a five-time Dakar motorcycle category winner, in one of three Aston Martin Dreadnoughts being built and run by Prodrive. Sebastien Loeb, the nine-time World Rally champion, and reigning World Rally Raid champion Lucas Moraes will drive the other Aston Martin Racing entries.
Alonso said: "After deciding to continue racing in Formula 1 with the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team, I thought carefully about Dakar.
"In the end, the decision became simple. I wanted to embrace the challenge completely and take on both Formula 1 and the Dakar Rally in the same year.
"In 2020, Dakar was one of the most challenging and enjoyable experiences of my career.

"I have enormous respect for this race and the specialists who have mastered it. Having Marc alongside me again is very important, and with Aston Martin, Prodrive, Sebastien and Lucas we have an exceptional team.
"Formula 1 remains my priority. But I am a racing driver, and challenges like this are why I love competing. I'm looking forward to seeing what we can achieve."
The Dreadnoughts will the competition-ready version of the car originally designed in digital form as a military vehicle for the new Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 video game

Aston Martin CEO Adrian Hallmark said: "Aston Martin Dreadnought was conceived to dominate any terrain, under the most extreme circumstances and come through it all to deliver on its mission. Now along with our engineering partner, Prodrive, we will challenge this vision in the most extreme competitive environment in global motorsport - the Dakar 2027.

"It is in Aston Martin's nature to forge forward with pioneering concepts, and just as we have always done, explore their limits on the global stage. We do not shy away from such challenges, but embrace them, and in Fernando, Sebastien and Lucas we have three great champions with whom to mount a formidable challenge on Dakar 2027."
The event covers a total distance of 7,824km, including 4,341km of special stages, and features all manner of challenging terrain and desert conditions
It begins in Loule, Faro in Portugal's Algarve with a prologue on January 9 and finishes in Marrakech, Morocco on January 23.
